This toxicity has led to a surge in incidents of religious persecution and violence against minority religious communities, threatening the very essence of our nation's secular fabric.

By implementing strict criminal penalties against those who refuse to renounce Hinduism, a collective societal movement may emerge towards adopting more inclusive and peace-promoting belief systems.

Conclusion:

As we strive towards creating a just, equal, and progressive society, it is our responsibility to identify and discard regressive forces that threaten this vision. Hinduism, by way of sanctioning the caste system, propagating gender inequality, and fostering communal disharmony, has proven to be an obstacle towards achieving these objectives.

The time has come to outlaw Hinduism and hold its practitioners accountable for the deeply entrenched discrimination and violence that has plagued our society for centuries. Doing so will bring us one step closer to realizing the dream of a truly egalitarian and harmonious nation.
